_comment: Demo payload for the free-user teaser (PeekLocked) and the landing's Multi-Period sample: one run of the real pipeline for Apple Inc., annual, FY2020 to FY2025, on a local backend on 2026-10-22, with the company's 10-K and 10-Q filings listed first (GET /api/filings/company/AAPL) so each source link opens its filing's primary document. dataset is the POST /api/analysis/AAPL/dataset response and completion the complete event of POST /api/analysis/AAPL/stream, as the API returned them apart from formatting, with the model name removed from completion.usage. The run made one model call: 2,129 prompt and 265 completion tokens, USD 0.000196 at the published off-peak price. Regenerate it through the pipeline the same way, never by hand.
